title: Sample Preparation for Automated Extraction in Periphyton Metabolomic Analysis
author: Lin Zi

steps.title: Prepare Periphyton Samples
steps.instruction: Process the 48-well plate after chemical exposure to prepare for extraction or exometabolome analysis.

substeps.instruction: Discard 850 µL of medium from each well, leaving approximately 150 µL to prevent desiccation.
For exometabolome analysis: transfer 850 µL medium from each well to a 1.1 mL Micronic tube, then discard 150 µL of that volume to leave 700 µL medium.

steps.title: Quench and Store Microplate
steps.instruction: Rapidly freeze the microplate to preserve sample integrity.

substeps.instruction: Seal the microplate with parafilm and secure it to the holder using tape.
Quench the microplate in liquid N2 for 00:05:00.
Seal the microplate again with parafilm and store in a -80 °C freezer.

steps.title: Prepare Micronic Tubes and Plate Plan
steps.instruction: Set up the collection tubes and documentation for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Weight empty 1.1 mL Micronic tubes (NBS MP32033L, without caps) and place them in a 96-well Micronic rack; close the rack lid.
Design a plate plan in Excel, ensuring each 96-well plate contains at least two blank tubes (one blank can be replaced by QC during injection).
Label the right side of the rack as 'Project_date, number of the plate' (e.g., 'Parc_12/2025, 1').

steps.title: Extract Periphyton with Ethanol
steps.instruction: Use cold ethanol and sonication to extract metabolites from the periphyton.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL cold 100% Grade UPLC EtOH to each well of the 48-well plate.
Place the plate in a beaker containing ice water, then place the beaker in a sonication bath for 00:05:00 (do not place the plate directly in the bath to avoid contamination).
Use a pipette to wash the discs and transfer the EtOH containing periphyton into the pre-weighted Micronic tubes.

steps.title: Dry Samples
steps.instruction: Remove ethanol from the samples using a vacuum concentrator.

substeps.instruction: Dry the EtOH using a GENEVAC (Hydro mode) until the sample is completely dry (estimated duration > 04:00:00).
If drying occurs the next day, store samples at 4 °C; if drying occurs several days later, store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Measure Dry Weight
steps.instruction: Determine the mass of the dried sample.

substeps.instruction: Measure the weight of the tubes plus dry samples (without caps).
Do not place the plate on ice during measurement to avoid humidity affecting the dry weight.

steps.title: Final Sample Preparation and Storage
steps.instruction: Prepare samples for grinding and long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Add one metal bead into each Micronic tube for sample grinding before closing the cap.
Store the Micronic plates at -80 °C before metabolite extraction.
